cand.title: GAINS FIT Experience Punta Cana 2027
cand.organizationName: GAINS FIT Retreat / MDK Holistic Wellness
cand.excerpt: Event page states dates, collaboration, registration and host resort.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified organizer-side relationship candidates: Maryam “Yama” Gidado, listed as GAINS FIT Director and MDK Holistic Wellness Owner on the Punta Cana team page; and Martha McNair-Russell, GAINS FIT Chief Liaison. Yama is the strongest programme/partner introduction; Martha is a useful organizer-routing contact. Neither source establishes hotel-contract signing authority. Use the published GAINS FIT office contact to request an introduction and identify the actual accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming activity dates are April 22–25, 2027, within the requested horizon. The dedicated event page and edition-specific checkout cancellation policy independently state these dates. Registration and final overnight-package payments close March 20, 2027. Wednesday arrival and nightly extensions are accommodation options, not evidence of a longer activity programme. No later Punta Cana edition was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional fit, not qualified volume: the published programme includes concurrent fitness breakouts, aqua formats, yoga, dance and private receptions/dinners. Wyndham Alltra’s official meetings page confirms 620 rooms, 380 m² across three event facilities, 300 conference/200 banquet capacity, beach/courtyard/garden options, a pool, fitness centre and spa. Inference: an all-inclusive residential wellness retreat fits the product better than a large exhibition or city convention, but dance-floor capacity is not the published seated conference capacity. Verify simultaneous class footprints, pool access, sound restrictions, flooring and indoor weather backup before pricing; unknown attendance prevents a capacity pass.
findings.venueCommitments: Dreams Royal Beach Punta Cana and Secrets Royal Beach Punta Cana are explicitly announced hosts. The edition-specific checkout sells stays by named property, room type and occupancy: this is substantive organizer booking evidence, not a generic preferred-hotel list. Publicly committed elsewhere; no executed contract, allotment size or exclusivity terms were available.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified advertised programme history: Las Vegas, September 18–21, 2025 at Aliante Casino Hotel Spa; Cancun, November 5–8, 2026 at Dreams Jade Resort and Spa. Both are past as of November 14, 2026, and neither is a current sales lead. The wider programme also advertises Bay Area, Chicago and Las Vegas retreats in 2027. These are distinct geographic events, not proof that one annual Punta Cana event rotates between destinations. No earlier Punta Cana edition or fixed return cycle was verified; historical listings establish advertised hosts, not independently audited event completion.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Attendee registration is open, but this must not be confused with open supplier procurement. The organizer sells Dreams/Secrets overnight packages directly, including property, room-category, occupancy and package-level selections; nonparticipating companion packages and nightly add-ons are also offered. The public FAQ routes enquiries to info@gainsfitretreat.com / 919-891-4348. General terms identify GAINS FIT Inc d/b/a GAINS FIT Retreat and reference hotel/vendor agreements; those older general terms do not prove the specific 2027 contract. No public hotel RFP, alternative-hotel invitation, named travel agency, PCO or DMC was identified. Further hotel sourcing is unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial fitness-retreat organizer rather than a verified association congress. GAINS FIT’s general terms name GAINS FIT Inc d/b/a GAINS FIT Retreat; its About page says the programme was created in 2014. The Punta Cana edition is a collaboration with MDK Holistic Wellness, whose principal identifies the business as MDK Holistic Wellness LLC. Dreams and Secrets are host hotels, not the event owner. No separately appointed agency/PCO/DMC was verified. Current legal standing and exact contracting entity require direct confirmation; the older terms are not a current corporate-status certificate.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 package already integrates two competing Royal Beach properties, with Dreams for adults/children and Secrets adults-only. Inference: an alternative single-property offer would need to address both lodging preferences and programme access. No sold-out notice, denied rooms, overflow requirement, incumbent shortcoming or hotel-switch request was verified. Do not translate this event into Wyndham room demand or treat the incumbent package as a prospectively available block.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the GAINS FIT office now and request an introduction to Yama Gidado and Martha McNair-Russell. Acknowledge the April 2027 Royal Beach arrangements; do not send a displacement or overflow quote without invitation. Ask who selects/contracts hotels, whether another Dominican Republic cycle is contemplated, and when site selection begins. Offer a future-cycle site inspection and a guestroom-led wellness proposal only after obtaining peak rooms, stay pattern, actual masterclass attendance, simultaneous breakouts and wet-weather requirements. Record 2027 as committed elsewhere and future capture as unqualified relationship development.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low for primary 2027 accommodation capture: venue and lodging products are already named and on sale elsewhere. Commercial supplier sourcing is not publicly open; any remaining procurement discretion, ancillary accommodation or overflow would need organizer confirmation. Attendee registration availability is not evidence that Wyndham can bid for the event.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-development potential only. Multiple destinations and years demonstrate an ongoing GAINS FIT programme, but not an annual Dominican Republic return or an available 2028 edition. Inference: position Wyndham for the next genuinely contestable Dominican Republic/all-inclusive retreat, contingent on destination intent, release dates, buyer authority, volume and activity-space suitability. No future room-night forecast is justified.
